briefing: Markets were neutral today (NASDAQ +0.5%, S&P 500 +0.3%) with no strong risk-on signal. Cash on hand ($189.29) is below the $500 deployment threshold, so per strategy memory we held all 7 positions rather than forcing a buy, and no stop-loss or profit-target conditions were triggered.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Patience in investing means resisting the urge to act just because you have idle cash or open portfolio slots. On a neutral day with limited cash, waiting for a clearer risk-on signal — rather than forcing a trade — protects capital for better opportunities.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 投資中的「耐性」是指不會單純因為手頭有閒置現金或組合有空位，就勉強進行交易。在大市方向不明、現金有限的日子，耐心等待更明確的「風險偏好」信號出現，而非強行入市，有助保留資金迎接更好的機會。

market_education.summary_en: Both major indices drifted modestly higher today without a clear catalyst, reflecting a quiet, directionless session rather than any major news event. Momentum names like EAT and MU continued showing bullish technicals, but broad market strength wasn't decisive enough to justify new capital deployment. With cash reserves already low, today was a session for patience rather than action.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市方向不明，納指升0.5%，標普500升0.3%，走勢溫和且缺乏明顯催化因素，屬於淡靜交投的一日。雖然EAT及MU等動能股技術指標仍然偏多，但大市升幅未足以構成強烈的「風險偏好」信號，未有充分理由動用資金開新倉。加上現金水平已低於部署門檻，今日策略以持有觀望為主。
